1) 从告警标签取 name 与 device，执行 docker exec \: 1) Take name and device from the alert labels and run docker exec <name> du -sh /* 2>/dev/null | sort -rh | head to find the biggest consumers; 2) In the vast majority of cases application logs are not being rotated: configure logrotate or switch to writing to stdout and let the runtime rotate them; 3) If the writable layer is filling up, mount a volume for directories that need persistence rather than writing into the layer; 4) As an emergency measure run docker system prune to reclaim host space from unused images and stopped containers.
1) 从告警标签取 name，执行 cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu: 1) Take name from the alert labels and confirm the growth of nr_throttled and throttled_usec with cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat (cgroup v2); 2) Compare actual CPU usage against the limit; being throttled while below the limit usually means bursts are being sliced up by the 100 ms period, so raise the limit slightly or lower in-period concurrency; 3) A common trigger is a JVM or Go runtime sizing thread pools from the host core count; set GOMAXPROCS or -XX:ActiveProcessorCount to match the limit; 4) If more compute is genuinely needed, raise the CPU limit and watch the throttling ratio fall.
1) 从告警标签取 name，执行 docker exec \u003cname: 1) Take name from the alert labels and run docker exec <name> cat /proc/net/dev plus ss -s to check drops and queue state; 2) If the receive queue is overflowing, raise the kernel's net.core.netdev_max_backlog and the application's accept queue (somaxconn); 3) Check whether the host NIC is also dropping packets (ethtool -S <nic> | grep -i drop); if the problem is at the host level, do not chase it inside the container; 4) If traffic genuinely exceeds the container's networking capacity, evaluate switching to host networking or raising the bandwidth allocation.
1) 从告警标签取 name，执行 docker inspect \u003cn: 1) Take name from the alert labels and confirm the OOMKilled state via the State.OOMKilled field in docker inspect <name> output or with kubectl describe pod; 2) Run dmesg -T | grep -i 'killed process' to find the killed process and its memory usage at the time; 3) Compare that usage against the limit and raise the limit if it is clearly too small; 4) If usage looks abnormal, investigate it as a memory leak; for Java, -Xmx must be smaller than the container limit with room for off-heap memory or an OOM is guaranteed.
1) 从告警标签取 name，执行 docker logs --tail 200: 1) Take name from the alert labels and run docker logs --tail 200 <name> or kubectl logs --previous to read the logs from before the last exit; 2) Run docker inspect <name> and check State.ExitCode and State.OOMKilled in the output to distinguish an OOM, a deliberate application exit, and a failing health check; 3) Handle OOMKilled as a memory alert; for a non-zero exit code, find the start-up failure in the application logs (missing configuration, dependency not ready); 4) If a health check is the cause, confirm the probe's initial delay is longer than the real start-up time and raise the start period if needed.
1) 从告警标签取 name，执行 docker stats \u003cnam: 1) Take name from the alert labels and run docker stats <name> or kubectl top pod to confirm live usage; 2) Use the application's own memory analysis inside the container (jmap -histo:live for Java, pprof heap for Go) to separate normal growth from a leak; 3) If the limit is simply too small, raise it and redeploy, adjusting the application's own heap ceiling to match (-Xmx must leave room for off-heap memory); 4) If it is a leak, estimate the remaining runway from the growth rate and add an automatic restart as a stopgap while you investigate the code.
容器可写层或挂载卷使用率已超过 85%，写满后应用会报 no space lef: The container's writable layer or mounted volume is more than 85% full. Once full, the application reports 'no space left on device' and both log and temporary file writes fail.
容器在最近 1 小时内启动时间变化超过 3 次，说明它在反复重启，服务处于不稳定: The container's start time has changed more than 3 times in the last hour, meaning it is restarting in a loop. The service is unstable and requests fail intermittently.
容器在最近 10 分钟内触发了 OOM 事件，说明进程已被内核因内存超限杀掉，正: The container triggered an OOM event in the last 10 minutes, meaning the kernel killed the process for exceeding its memory limit. In-flight requests have already failed.
容器工作集内存已达到内存 limit 的 90%，再涨就会被 cgroup OO: The container's working set has reached 90% of its memory limit. Any further growth will get it killed by the cgroup OOM killer, restarting the container and interrupting in-flight requests.
容器网络接收方向丢包速率超过 1 包/秒，可能是接收队列溢出或网络配置异常，会造: The container is dropping more than 1 received packet per second, which may indicate a full receive queue or a network misconfiguration and will cause TCP retransmits and higher request latency.
容器超过 25% 的 CFS 调度周期被限流，说明 CPU limit 已成为瓶: More than 25% of the container's CFS scheduling periods are throttled, meaning the CPU limit has become the bottleneck. This shows up as pronounced latency spikes and worse P99.
